major_red_flags: The report's central hypothesis (lactide incorporation increases Tg) is contradicted by its own cited evidence [3] which states glycolide incorporation reduces Tg relative to pure PLA. The proposed lactide-glycolide copolymer (PLGA) is known in literature to have lower Tg than PLA, directly opposing the design objective of increasing Tg.
chemical_validity.rationale: The report demonstrates good chemical understanding of PLA/PLGA systems and maintains internal consistency in methods and evidence discussion. However, a fundamental contradiction exists: the design goal is to increase Tg, but lactide-glycolide copolymers (PLGA) are well-established to have lower Tg than PLA homopolymer due to glycolide's chain-flexibilizing effect. The report acknowledges this in section 2.1 but proceeds with the contradictory hypothesis. This invalidates the central thermal design objective, though mechanical ductility pathways remain plausible.
